value.rationale: The four-oval model is a natural exact mass-action oscillator built to study multiple attracting chemical cycles. For that same physically specified clock, different translated x y weights yield two sharply unequal diverging periods while the unshifted geometric normal contraction per return remains identical for all four. The rational ratio 13/7 and explicit I_c are motivated critical invariants that distinguish time from orbital stability and meaningfully quantify the original source’s singular four-oval merger, rather than arbitrary parametrized toy slices.
